name: British Heart Foundation
summary: The UK's largest charitable funder of heart and circulatory research; also runs health information and support, CPR training and the national defibrillator network, and campaigns on policy. Its 651 shops help pay for it.

programs.label: Research grants, implementation pilots and policy work
programs.weight_source: https://www.bhf.org.uk/what-we-do/-/media/files/annual_report_and_accounts_2025-26.pdf (Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26, p. 109): research £96.2m plus policy and influencing (our judgment of 6% of health expenditure of £54.2m) and Healthcare Implementation Fund pilots (our judgment of 5%), £5.96m, year to 31 March 2026, in pounds.

programs.label: Information, the Heart Helpline, peer support, CPR and defibrillators
programs.weight_source: https://www.bhf.org.uk/what-we-do/-/media/files/annual_report_and_accounts_2025-26.pdf (Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26, p. 109): health expenditure £54.2m less the policy and implementation-pilot shares above (89%, £48.24m), year to 31 March 2026, in pounds.
